page.description: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server: what it is, who it is for, and where SUSE publishes it.
page.intro: SUSE's commercial enterprise server distribution, the base of openSUSE Leap. SUSE publishes the media and the support terms; ROMinit does not pin an image for it.
pros: Long service packs and life cycles with defined support phases.
Certified for SAP, SAP HANA and a wide hardware catalogue.
YaST and the SUSE tooling carry over to openSUSE Leap.
Enterprise support, updates and certifications from one vendor.
cons: Requires a SUSE subscription for updates and support.
Media are behind SUSE's customer centre, not a public ISO list.
openSUSE Leap tracks it, but is a separate product with its own media.
SUSE's life-cycle page states the dates; none is repeated here.
page.previewNote: Information-only page: SUSE supplies the media and ROMinit does not pin or test an image here.
page.status: SUSE publishes and supports its own media. This page only points at SUSE's product, life-cycle and download pages; there is nothing to download from ROMinit and no USB path.
